checkpoint_review: I have revised my assessment of the 'Head is large and triangular...' checkpoint. Therefore, I revert to agreeing with the Router that this feature is not clearly present. The coloration failure (albino vs green) and missing eye/shield details remain valid failures. Limb/digit fusion is confirmed visually despite the pose auditor's high confidence.

The skin texture is indeed waxy and lacks granular definition (severity 3). While the topology mask is clean, it fails to capture the internal anatomical defects. The pose auditor's 'MINIMAL' risk rating is a false negative regarding limb integrity and is overridden by visual evidence of fusion. These combined issues justify a very low artifact score.

artifact_reasoning: Severe structural artifact: Limbs and digits exhibit significant fusion with the background grass, lacking distinct anatomical separation (Severity 4). Although the overall silhouette is coherent (high mask confidence), the internal anatomy of the feet is malformed. Pose auditor confidence is disregarded due to visible fusion.
